intro: One table, a steel ball and two flippers. Keep the ball in play, hit everything you can, and take turns: each player plays a ball, then passes the table on, until everyone's balls are gone.
inspiredBy: Pinball tables go back to the 1930s, and flippers arrived in 1947. This table is our own: our own layout, lights, colours and sounds.
goal: The highest score when everyone's balls are gone. Playing on your own? Beat the best scores.
howToPlay: Join with your phone. In the lobby choose how many balls each player gets, then press {bolt} to start. Players take turns in the order they joined.
On your turn, hold {bolt} to pull the plunger back and let go to launch. The further you pull, the faster the ball goes: pull at least a third of the way or it rolls back.
{l1} and {r1} are the left and right flippers. Hold a flipper up to catch the ball on it, then let go and flip again to aim.
Flick the stick to nudge the table and push the ball. Nudge too often and the table tilts: the flippers go dead and you lose the ball and its bonus.
Roll through the three lanes at the top to light them. Light all three and the bonus multiplier goes up, to 5×. Each flip moves the lit lanes along, so you can line up the dark one.
Hit all three yellow targets on the left wall for the jackpot: 5,000.
Lose the ball in the first few seconds after a launch (while SAVE is lit) and it comes straight back, once a ball.
When the ball drains, its bonus is paid times the multiplier, and the next player's ball starts.
Press ❚❚ on your phone to pause.
steering: Flick the stick to nudge the table
tips: Don't flip at everything: hold a flipper up, catch the ball, and aim your shot.
A ball off the tip of the flipper goes across the table; off the middle, it goes up the far side.
The bumpers do the scoring for you: send the ball up between them.
A small nudge as the ball heads for an outlane can save it. Then leave the table alone for a bit.
